channel.markdownDescription:
CAN interface name

CAN interface name (e.g., 'can0', 'can1', 'vcan0' for testing).
channel.title: Channel

bitrate.markdownDescription:
CAN bus bitrate in bps

CAN bus speed. Default 125000 (125kbps) is compatible with esphome-canopen.
All devices on the same bus must use the same bitrate.
bitrate.title: Bitrate

node_id.markdownDescription:
CANopen node ID (1-127 or 'auto')

Unique node identifier on the CAN bus (1-127).
'auto' generates a deterministic ID from MAC address and persists it.
Manual override: set an integer 1-127.
node_id.title: Node id

mode.markdownDescription:
CAN bus mode

master: Device has LAN/MQTT, relays slave data to Home Assistant.
slave: Device has no LAN, sends data only via CAN bus.
mode.title: Mode

auto_setup.markdownDescription:
Auto-setup CAN interface

Automatically configure CAN interface on startup using
'sudo ip link set'. Requires sudoers NOPASSWD for boneio user.
auto_setup.title: Auto setup

restart_on_error.description: Restart CAN interface on bus-off error
restart_on_error.markdownDescription:
Restart CAN interface on bus-off error

Automatically restart CAN interface when bus-off state is detected.
Requires sudoers NOPASSWD for boneio user.
restart_on_error.title: Restart on error

can.description: CAN bus configuration for inter-device communication via CANopen protocol.
can.title: Can
